name: workdesk-utility
description: Free cross-platform work utility with Windows network tools

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && npm run build:electron && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --dir
scripts.package:win: tsc --noEmit && vite build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win portable
scripts.package:mac: tsc --noEmit && vite build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --mac dmg
